preconditions.description: The number of chairs n is between 2 and 5000 inclusive.
Scott's starting position s is between 1 and n inclusive.
Darren Cross's position e is between 1 and n inclusive.
Scott's starting position s is not the same as Darren Cross's position e.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi for xi in x)
preconditions.description: Each coordinate xi is at least 1.

preconditions.expression: all(xi < xj for i, xi in enumerate(x) for j, xj in enumerate(x) if i < j)
preconditions.description: The coordinates x are strictly increasing.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 10**9 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each ai is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= bi <= 10**9 for bi in b)
preconditions.description: Each bi is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ci <= 10**9 for ci in c)
preconditions.description: Each ci is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= di <= 10**9 for di in d)
preconditions.description: Each di is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is the minimum time Scott needs to visit each chair exactly once and end up on chair number e.
